median.name: Median
median.description: Middle value; interpolated for even counts.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: All most frequent values; undefined when all values occur once.

population_variance.name: Population variance
population_variance.description: Variance treating observations as the population.

sample_variance.name: Sample variance
sample_variance.description: Unbiased sample variance; requires two observations.

population_std.name: Population standard deviation
population_std.description: Population spread in the original units.

mean_absolute_deviation.name: Mean absolute deviation
mean_absolute_deviation.description: Average absolute distance from the mean.

median_absolute_deviation.name: Median absolute deviation
median_absolute_deviation.description: Unscaled robust spread about the median.

iqr.name: Interquartile range
iqr.description: Spread of the middle half of the data.

coefficient_of_variation.name: Coefficient of variation (%)
coefficient_of_variation.description: Relative sample spread; undefined at mean zero.

percentiles.name: Percentiles
percentiles.description: Requested percentile positions, using linear interpolation.

skewness.name: Sample skewness
skewness.description: Bias-corrected asymmetry; undefined for constant data or n < 3.

excess_kurtosis.name: Sample excess kurtosis
excess_kurtosis.description: Bias-corrected excess; g2=m4/m2²−3. Requires n >= 4 and spread.

standard_error.name: Standard error of the mean
standard_error.description: Estimated sampling error using sample standard deviation.

iqr_outliers.name: IQR outliers
iqr_outliers.formula: x < Q1−1.5 IQR or x > Q3+1.5 IQR

z_outliers.name: Z-score outliers
z_outliers.description: Observations over three population standard deviations away.

frequency.name: Frequency distribution
frequency.description: Exact values with absolute, relative, and cumulative frequencies.

geometric_mean.name: Geometric mean
geometric_mean.description: Multiplicative average; requires strictly positive values.

harmonic_mean.name: Harmonic mean
harmonic_mean.description: Reciprocal average; requires strictly positive values.

weighted_mean.name: Weighted mean
weighted_mean.description: Requires one nonnegative weight per included observation and positive total weight.

pearson.name: Pearson correlation
pearson.description: Linear association for paired observations; both columns must vary.

spearman.name: Spearman correlation
spearman.description: Rank correlation with average ranks for ties.

regression.name: Simple linear regression
regression.description: Ordinary least squares; includes R². Requires varying x.
